audit_findings: The Fresh opaque extractor deterministically identifies real MCP/agent-facing registration surfaces but emits no pre-existing Candidate-5.8 seed identity, blind transport authority, anchor contract, canonical signature, execution profile, declared worlds, or claim-critical coordinate/resource binding authority.

The frozen Candidate-58 preparation path requires a sanitized 58-case manifest with SYN-PY/GO/TS seed identities plus frozen blind transport, anchor, signature, profile and world bundles; those authorities are intrinsic to the old synthetic/development lineage and cannot honestly be projected onto arbitrary fresh repository surfaces after seeing source.

The frozen C1 direct source checker requires an existing signature and contract containing target-function/guard/effect/success/rejection and binding identities. It is an independent verifier of those authorities, not a prospective generator of missing semantic authority for arbitrary fresh surfaces.
Gate2D explicitly forbids post-hoc support-profile addition, generic normalization, support widening, and definitive promotion without exact context-bound source/projection/binding authority.

Therefore a first-complete FreshEpistemic10 R1 run under the current frozen system would either fabricate/widen authority or conservatively collapse the fresh units to INCOMPLETE for missing admissible authority. The former violates scientific hygiene; the latter consumes a one-shot clean target while providing almost no information about nontrivial real-world selectivity.
no_reuse_claim: The 39-repository R1 candidate universe will not later be presented as the first clean heldout for a bridge whose design was informed by its repository metadata. Its target source remains unread, but this R1 challenge is closed to avoid metadata-aware benchmark tailoring disputes.
